lots.title: Provision of Minor Disability Adaptations (minor building works) in privately owned properties
lots.description: Lot 11 of the London Borough of Bexley 6278 - Building Services Framework, covering the provision of minor disability adaptations (minor building works) in privately owned properties. The document itself is the PSQ (Pre-Qualification) reference appendices — it contains a Reference Form (Appendix 1) to be completed by an applicant and returned by a referee, together with a covering letter (Appendix 2). It does not contain a full technical specification, quantitative requirements, or tender evaluation matrix; those items are expected in separate documents within the same tender pack.
requirements: Applicant must supply a contactable referee who can attest to the quality of services previously delivered (Appendix 1, Part A).
Referee must return Part B of the reference form to procurement@bexley.gov.uk by 18th May 2026, 5pm, and not return it to the applicant.

evaluation_criteria.summary: Referee's overall opinion of the provider / contractor / supplier and the quality of service or workmanship delivered, judged against measurable outcomes of the contract held.
evaluation_criteria.weighting_text: 5-point scale: failed in all areas / failed in some areas / met standard / exceeded in some areas / exceeded in all areas.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: Your overall opinion of this provider/ contractor/ supplier and the quality of service/ workmanship delivered in terms of measurable outcomes against the contract held

evaluation_criteria.summary: Referee's assessment of the contractor's adherence to and compliance with the service schedule or specification in place on the reference contract.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: Adherence to & compliance with your service schedule/ specification

evaluation_criteria.summary: Ability of the contractor / provider / supplier to resolve problems quickly and effectively on the reference contract.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: Ability of the contractor/ provider/ supplier to resolve problems quickly and effectively.

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Safe, secure, sensitive and reliable delivery
evaluation_criteria.summary: Whether the contractor / provider / supplier delivered services or goods that were generally safe, secure, sensitive and reliable — especially relevant given the residential, often occupied and vulnerable settings implied by the minor disability adaptations work.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: Did the contractor/ provider/ supplier provide the services/ goods that were generally safe, secure, sensitive and reliable?

evaluation_criteria.summary: Effectiveness of the contractor's communication with both the client body and the residents, with explicit emphasis on occupied properties and vulnerable households.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: How effective was the contractor’s communication with both the client and residents, particularly in occupied properties and vulnerable households

evaluation_criteria.summary: Referee's Yes/No confirmation of whether they would re-employ the applicant company for similar services — used as a summary signal alongside the five rated criteria.
